explication: OpenStrap Edge is a private-by-default wearable health app. The main user journey is pairing a supported band, syncing its data through the phone app, and viewing health snapshots through phone, widget, watch, or shortcut surfaces. Native Android and iOS code supports pairing, background operation, platform health integrations, and companion surfaces. The tree does not include the main Flutter/Dart application, so its sync and health-data processing stages cannot be mapped in detail; several widget and platform subsystems are represented from the tree and README rather than sampled implementation.
